title: Description of Requirements for the Development of an Agricultural Autonomous Vehicle with Artificial Intelligence
content: Autonomous vehicles (AV) applications can extend to reach variable fields, some fields are more impacted with this interference than others, farming, wildfire detecting, search and rescue, weed control, and livestock management are critical and can be enhanced in large range using the integration between artificial intelligence (AI) and AV’s. Thus, in this research, we try to describe a process of making a singular multitask AV with sufficient processing power, and an accurate AI functionality to perform such tasks in real time.  In order to achieve such target, multiple requirements are essential such as an accurate flight controller, a high-end processing unite, and aerodynamical design to operate in severe weather conditions, as well as precise and high-quality materials for 3D-printing and execution.
